For years, price has attempted to break the $20 monthly resistance zone.

Four attempts, all failed.

Probability suggests that level eventually breaks and flips to support.

Before that higher move, I’d personally like to see a sweep of the $11.20 liquidity to build proper strength.

While price could move up from here, it’s not a setup I find attractive right now.

For now, $OSCR stays on my developing-to-trade watchlist.
